phone.none.title: No phone linked
phone.none.body: Link a phone running the NoCap OS app in Settings → Devices, then its screen shows here.
phone.pick.title: Choose a phone
phone.pick.body: Which phone’s screen do you want to see?
phone.link.nearbyHint: The phone is on the same network as this server
phone.link.remoteHint: The phone connects to this server over the internet
phone.jpegHint: This browser can’t play the phone’s video, so it shows still pictures instead (slower).
phone.st.askingBody: Your phone is asking whether to share its screen. Tap Accept, then Start now.
phone.st.waitingBody: Open NoCap OS on the phone with the screen on. The request appears there.
phone.st.deniedBody: Nothing is shared. Ask again when you’re ready to accept on the phone.
phone.st.unsupported: This phone can’t share its screen
phone.st.unsupportedBody: Its Android version or the NoCap OS app is too old. Update the app and try again.
phone.st.goneBody: It was unlinked, or it isn’t yours. Choose another phone.
phone.controlOff: Control is off. To tap and type from here, turn on NoCap OS in the phone’s Accessibility settings.
phone.hint: Click to tap, drag to swipe, scroll to scroll, type to type. Right-click or Esc goes back.
